picks.execution: User confirmed loss; settled at $0 payout.

model_learning.lesson: Do not equate heavy rotation with loss of structural quality. Evaluate the rotated XI relative to the opponent, especially when an elite/deep top-tier squad faces a lower-tier side.
model_learning.implementation: v0.3.5 adds tier_gap, squad_depth and rotation depth-mismatch/resilience terms. Negative lineup penalties can be softened when pre-match evidence shows the second unit still has a large quality edge.
model_learning.guardrail: One 5-0 result is a learning example, not coefficient calibration. Backtest the interaction on historical point-in-time cup lineups. Win probability and -2.5 cover probability remain separate outputs.

note: Sep 17 post-settlement update. The $10 Europa combo was confirmed lost. City-Norwich is incorporated as a model-design lesson: relative squad quality and tier/depth mismatch must offset naive rotation penalties, subject to historical backtesting. Gambling can result in loss of principal.
